Cause: The `documents` namespace enforces the PodSecurity "restricted" standard. The 1.5.0 rollout updated the Deployment's pod template, but the new ReplicaSet (pdf-exporter-5f6b8d9c47) cannot create pods because the exporter container does not meet restricted-profile requirements. The 1.4.2 pods keep running because they were admitted before (or under a laxer template). The `set image` only changes the image tag, so any securityContext gaps in the existing template remain and the new ReplicaSet is rejected.

Evidence: Logs from deploy-pdf-exporter-28591340-wq7mz show `kubectl set image` succeeded, then `rollout status` timed out, and the ReplicaSet event was:
  FailedCreate ... pods "pdf-exporter-5f6b8d9c47-8xq2d" is forbidden: violates PodSecurity "restricted:latest":
    - allowPrivilegeEscalation != false
    - unrestricted capabilities (must drop ["ALL"])
    - runAsNonRoot != true
    - seccompProfile not set to RuntimeDefault/Localhost
Meanwhile `kubectl -n documents get pods` still shows two 1.4.2 pods Running and zero 1.5.0 pods, confirming no new pod was ever admitted.

Fix (owner applies to the pdf-exporter Deployment manifest, then redeploys):
Add a securityContext to the `exporter` container (and/or pod) that satisfies the restricted profile [cite: concepts/security/pod-security-standards#restricted-3] [cite: concepts/security/pod-security-standards#restricted-8] [cite: concepts/security/pod-security-standards#restricted-5], for example [cite: concepts/workloads/pods/advanced-pod-config#container-level-security-context-0]:

  securityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 1000           # any non-zero UID the image supports
    capabilities:
      drop: ["ALL"]
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault

Re-run the deploy-pdf-exporter pipeline after this change; the new ReplicaSet will then be admitted and the rollout will complete. (The image tag bump itself is not the problem — the same manifest change would fail on 1.4.2 too if re-admitted.)
